Name: Rest and Recover
Author: PanKoziolek
Description:
[size=6]🌿 Rest and Recover[/size]
This mod was created from scratch. Although other mods explore a similar concept, Rest and Recover features its own implementation, extensive configuration options, ambient comfort bonuses, visual effects, persistent statistics, and localization support.
[heading]💺 Sit. Relax. Recover.[/heading]
Transform sitting into a meaningful and immersive gameplay mechanic.
Rest and Recover allows your farmer to naturally restore ⚡ Energy and ❤ Health simply by sitting on chairs, benches, sofas, armchairs, stools, and other compatible furniture.
Instead of eating every time you run out of energy, take a moment to sit down, enjoy your surroundings, and let your character recover naturally over time.
[heading]✨ Features[/heading]
✔ Restore ⚡ Energy while sitting.
✔ Restore ❤ Health while sitting.
✔ Separate configurable regeneration rates.
✔ ⏳ Configurable delay before regeneration begins.
✔ 📊 Countdown until recovery starts.
✔ ⏱ Estimated time until full recovery.
✔ 📈 Animated progress bar displayed above your character.
✔ 🪑 Different comfort bonuses for different seat types.
✔ 🔥 Optional bonus from nearby lit fireplaces.
✔ 📺 Ambient bonuses from televisions and music players.
✔ 🌱 Stackable comfort bonuses from nearby decorative plants.
✔ 🐾 Optional bonus from a nearby pet.
✔ 🌧 Indoor weather bonuses during rain, snow, and storms.
✔ 👥 Bonus for resting near another sitting player.
✔ ✨ Configurable particles, animations, completion flash, and sounds.
✔ ⏩ Optional game-time acceleration while resting.
✔ 📊 Persistent rest statistics for every save file.
✔ 🎮 Multiplayer-aware behavior.
✔ ⚙ Full Generic Mod Config Menu support.
✔ 🛋 Support for standard seats and many compatible furniture mods.
✔ 🔌 Public API for other SMAPI mods and add-ons.
✔ 🌍 Thirteen included language files.
[heading]🪑 Seat Comfort System[/heading]
Not every seat is equally comfortable.
The mod detects several furniture categories:
🪑 Chair
🪵 Bench
💺 Armchair
🛋 Sofa / Couch
🔸 Stool
📦 Other or Modded Seats
Each category has its own configurable regeneration multiplier.
Relaxing on a comfortable sofa can restore Energy and Health faster than sitting on a simple wooden stool. Unknown compatible seats automatically use the configurable Other Seat multiplier.
The entire seat multiplier system can also be disabled if you prefer the same recovery speed for every seat.
[heading]🔥 Fireplace and Ambient Comfort[/heading]
Your surroundings can make resting even more effective.
🔥 Lit Fireplace
Resting near a genuinely lit fireplace can provide an additional regeneration multiplier.
You can configure:
🔥 Enable or disable the bonus
📏 Fireplace detection radius
✨ Regeneration multiplier
An unlit fireplace will not provide the bonus.
📺 Television
A nearby television can provide a small comfort bonus while you rest.
🎵 Jukebox and Record Player
Nearby music players can improve recovery, including the vanilla Mini-Jukebox and compatible modded jukeboxes or record players.
🌱 Decorative Plants
Nearby plants can provide a small stackable bonus. You can configure the bonus per plant and the maximum number of plants that may contribute.
🐾 Pet
Your nearby cat or dog can provide an additional comfort bonus.
🌧 Indoor Weather
Resting indoors while it rains, snows, or storms outside can grant separate configurable weather bonuses.
👥 Resting Together
In multiplayer, resting near another player who is also sitting can provide an additional Together bonus.
Every ambient bonus can be enabled, disabled, and balanced through the configuration menu.
[heading]📊 Rest HUD[/heading]
While resting, the HUD can display useful information such as:
⏳ Time until regeneration begins
⚡ Estimated Energy recovery time
❤ Estimated Health recovery time
📈 Estimated time until full recovery
🪑 Current seat type and comfort multiplier
🔥 Active fireplace bonus
✨ Active ambient comfort bonuses
✅ Fully rested status
The HUD position and scale can be customized.
[heading]📈 Floating Progress Bar and Visual Effects[/heading]
An animated progress bar can be displayed above your character while recovering.
Available visual options include:
📍 Configurable bar height
📏 Configurable bar scale
🎨 Dynamic color based on recovery progress
🌫 Smooth fade-in and fade-out
〰 Smooth progress animation
💓 Subtle pulsing effect
✨ Floating recovery particles
💥 Completion flash
🔊 Start and completion sounds
🎛 Low, Medium, and High visual quality settings
The HUD panel, floating progress bar, particles, animations, and completion feedback can be configured separately.
[heading]📊 Persistent Rest Statistics[/heading]
Rest and Recover tracks statistics separately for every save file.
Tracked information includes:
⏱ Total time spent resting
⚡ Total Energy restored
❤ Total Health restored
🛋 Number of rest sessions
🪑 Favorite seat type
🔥 Time spent resting near a fireplace
🌧 Time spent resting with an indoor weather bonus
👥 Time spent resting near another player
Statistics can be viewed through Generic Mod Config Menu.
Console commands are also available:
[code]rest_stats[/code]— display statistics for the current save
[code]rest_reset_stats[/code]— reset statistics for the current save
[heading]⚙ Configuration[/heading]
Almost every part of the mod can be customized.
Available options include:
⚡ Energy regeneration rate
❤ Health regeneration rate
⏳ Delay before regeneration starts
🪑 Individual seat comfort multipliers
🔥 Fireplace bonus and detection radius
📺 Television and music bonuses
🌱 Plant bonuses and maximum plant count
🐾 Pet comfort bonus
🌧 Rain, snow, and storm bonuses
👥 Resting Together bonus and radius
📊 HUD visibility, position, and scale
📈 Progress bar scale and height
🎨 Progress bar animations and visual quality
✨ Recovery particles and completion effects
🔊 Start and completion sounds
⏩ Time acceleration and speed multiplier
🌾 Optional farm-only mode
✋ Optional empty-hands requirement
⏸ Optional pause while menus are open
⌨ Configurable settings-menu hotkey
The easiest way to configure the mod is through Generic Mod Config Menu.
By default, the settings menu can be opened with [b]F10[/b] when GMCM is installed.
[heading]⏩ Optional Time Acceleration[/heading]
The in-game clock can optionally run faster during a valid rest session.
Time acceleration begins after the configured recovery delay and can continue for the entire valid rest session, including after Energy and Health have been fully restored.
This feature is disabled by default.
In multiplayer, only the host is allowed to modify the shared game clock, preventing farmhands from changing world time independently.
[heading]👥 Multiplayer[/heading]
Rest and Recover includes multiplayer-aware behavior.
✔ Players recover through their own rest sessions.
✔ The optional Together bonus requires another nearby player to also be sitting.
✔ Only the host can accelerate shared game time.
✔ Rest statistics are stored with the relevant save file.
[heading]🌍 Included Languages[/heading]
Rest and Recover includes localization files for all languages officially supported by Stardew Valley, plus Polish:
🇬🇧 English
🇩🇪 German
🇪🇸 Spanish
🇧🇷 Brazilian Portuguese
🇷🇺 Russian
🇯🇵 Japanese
🇨🇳 Simplified Chinese
🇮🇹 Italian
🇫🇷 French
🇰🇷 Korean
🇹🇷 Turkish
🇭🇺 Hungarian
🇵🇱 Polish 

Additional translations can be added through SMAPI’s standard translation system.
[heading]🔌 Public API[/heading]
Rest and Recover provides a public API for compatible SMAPI mods and add-ons.
Other mods can:
✔ Check whether a player is resting.
✔ Start or stop Rest and Recover processing.
✔ Read the current comfort multiplier.
✔ Access rest statistics.
✔ Respond to rest start and stop events.

[heading]🛠 Requirements and Compatibility[/heading]
Designed for:
✔ Stardew Valley 1.6 or later
✔ SMAPI 4.0 or later
Generic Mod Config Menu is optional but strongly recommended for convenient in-game configuration.
The mod supports Stardew Valley’s standard sitting furniture system. Many compatible custom furniture items should work automatically, while unknown seats use the configurable Other Seat multiplier.
[heading]📥 Installation[/heading]
1️⃣ Install SMAPI.
2️⃣ Optionally install Generic Mod Config Menu.
3️⃣ Download Rest and Recover.
4️⃣ Extract the mod into:
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]5️⃣ Launch the game through SMAPI.
6️⃣ Sit down, relax, and recover. ☕

[size=5][b]❤️ Special Thanks[/b][/size]
A special thank you to CNSCZJ for creating the Simplified Chinese translation and helping bring Rest and Recover to even more players around the world.

[heading]❤️ Support and Feedback[/heading]
If you encounter an issue or have a suggestion for a future update, please leave a comment on the mod page.
🐞 Bug reports
💡 Feature requests
⚖ Balance suggestions
🌍 Translation corrections
📝 General feedback
When reporting a problem, please include:
📄 Your SMAPI log
🎮 Stardew Valley version
🔧 SMAPI version
📦 Rest and Recover version
📝 A short description of the issue
📸 Screenshots or video, if possible
📋 A list of other installed mods, if relevant

Your feedback helps improve Rest and Recover and makes future updates even better.
❤️ Thank you for downloading and supporting Rest and Recover! 🌿
